name: BigML
summary: Machine-learning and AutoML platform for building and deploying models, with a lasting free plan and paid subscriptions that officially start at 27 €/month.
description: Machine-learning and AutoML platform for building and deploying models, with a lasting free plan and paid subscriptions that officially start at 27 €/month.

pricing.details: A 3-day free trial of full access (up to 60 tasks, no credit card) is offered alongside a lasting Free plan. Free 0 € — unlimited tasks, max dataset size 16 MB per task, 2 parallel tasks per user, 1 user included (additional users via an organization account). Paid subscriptions officially start at 27 €/month (monthly; 15% off quarterly; 30% off yearly). The detailed grid by dataset size was not isolated and is not listed. A 50% off mention for students, public researchers or NGOs is stated without a public resulting price and is not itemized. Private deployments: Lite 9,048 €/year or 905 €/month; Bronze Enterprise 40,717 €/year + 9,048 € setup. Extra support and training or certification prices appear on the same page and remain in the official notes.
